tips.text: Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant and leave Neuroptics relics Intact; Radiant lowers Common odds to 16.67%.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; you keep the item and they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Buy extra relics for Wukong Prime Blueprint; it is the Rare in every one of them.
Bank Aya before her rotation opens; it never expires.
